xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: 1. Ms. Pratima Umarji (DIN: 05294496), Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, has resigned from the Board of Directors of the Company w.e.f. November 03, 2025, due to her ongoing health concerns. Consequent to her resignation as Independent Director, she ceased to be a member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Chairperson of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee of the Company w.e.f. November 03, 2025. Her membership in the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Stakeholders Relationship Committee has been considered in this Corporate Governance Report till November 03, 2025. which falls within the relevant quarter of reporting for a better understanding of the stakeholders. 2. Mr. Kaushik Shah (DIN: 00124756), Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, an existing member of the Stakeholders Relationship Committee, was appointed as the Chairperson of the Committee w.e.f. November 07, 2025. 3. Ms. Rashi Mehta (DIN:10420079), Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, has been appointed as a Member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Stakeholders Relationship Committee w.e.f. November 07, 2025. 4. Accordingly, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Stakeholders Relationship Committee have been reconstituted on November 07, 2025.
